$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the item-kind vocabulary shared by the bridges and the CLI. Every kind string the C# ItemKind.Map can emit is listed here. A bare entry => the CLI materializes it as a workspace file (or folder) and MUST have a matching packages/volt-cli/src/registry/extensions.ts entry; whether that file is writable (a source POU) or read-only reference is the CLI's per-extension concern (defaultAccess), not the wire's. The only kinds that carry a `family` are the exceptions that DON'T become files: family inlined => the item lives inside a POU's .st text; family container => a wire kind that is never materialized. Enforced by packages/volt-cli/src/tests/registry/vocabulary.test.ts, which cross-checks this file against BOTH ItemKind.cs (the bridge) and extensions.ts (the CLI): changing any one of the three without the others fails the test.
